name: AISourceTile
description: AISourceTile surfaces a single knowledge input, data source, citation, attached file, or capability dependency in detail drawers and inspector panels. It composes AIIcon (container + treatment="ai-contained") so the icon tile inherits the brand container chrome correctly and avoids the manual .zs-master-style wrapper bug.
intent: Tinted icon square + bold title + uppercase source caption — for knowledge inputs, citations, attached files.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: source
props.hint: Uppercase caption shown beneath the title.

props.name: iconName
props.hint: ZAIDYN icon class for the leading tile.

props.name: chevron
props.hint: Show a right-facing chevron affordance. Auto-true when onClick is provided. Suppressed when rank is set.

props.name: subtitle
props.hint: Second line under the title (mixed-case body-compact). Wins over `source` when both are set.

props.name: selectable
props.hint: Turn the leading icon square into a checkbox tile. Combine with `selected` + `onSelect` for multi-select behavior.

props.name: selected
props.hint: Selectable-only. Selected rows carry a brand-tinted background + border.

props.name: onSelect
props.hint: Selectable-only. Row becomes role="checkbox" with Space/Enter toggling.

props.name: onClick
props.hint: When set, the tile becomes a clickable button and auto-enables the chevron + hover state.

notes: Use AI tokens from ai-tokens.ts — do not hardcode brand hex.
Fetch dependency atomics from components/ai/ mirror specs.
Self-contained under components/ai/ — do not require @zaidyn/ai-ui.

keyboard: Ensure keyboard focus order matches visual order

forbiddenUsage: Do not invent dependency atomics — use bundled canonical sources
Do not hardcode brand hex — use AI tokens
Do not require @zaidyn/ai-ui for agent implementations — use co-located TSX
